name: feature-designer
description: Formatted view of the Orlando feature specifications (designs/features) with a hover "+" to insert existing diagrams. Markdown stays the only storage; edits go through VS Code's document API.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Feature Designer runs the repository's design tooling (Python), so it needs a trusted workspace.

commands.title: Feature Designer: Resolve Interrupted Apply to Source
Feature Designer: Review Moved Diagram Sources…

featureDesigner.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter that runs `python -m tools.design` (machine-level only; a workspace or folder setting is ignored, so a repository cannot choose the program that runs). When empty, Feature Designer offers the repository's `.venv` interpreter and saves it only after you confirm.
